title: i built a better version of 82-0 and got 4000 users in a day
author: ivyleaguedegen
selftext:
built this using primarily codex, with claude code for front end. 

drew the screens on excalidraw and gave some high level inputs and extraneous ideas to claude code and let it cook.   
  
you get a deck of 15 nba players across eras and have to build your best starting five using 9 category fantasy basketball rules.  
  
there’s pvp, elo, all that so you can finally prove who the real ball knowers in the friend group are. 

game is free so try on [startingfive.gg](http://startingfive.gg)

comments.author: Aromatic-Low-4578
comments.body: Where did you advertise it to get those players?

replies.author: ivyleaguedegen
replies.body: literally just made a post on x and then reddit. it's a multiplayer game and to play you send it to friends, so i guess it just grew exponentially because one person would send it to 3 three people, they would send it to 3 more etc

comments.author: HobiAI
comments.body: I am sorry, just curious. Won't NBA sue you for unauthorized use of those names?

replies.author: Nervous_Teach_5596
replies.body: Technically any company can do that by using their IP, and get almost free money

replies.author: ivyleaguedegen
replies.body: Yeah usage of names and stats has been defended via fantasy sports multiple times in court. The issue would be if I used the NBA logo or team logos/iconography
